title.zh: 新世界模型Odyssey-3物理评测66.1分超FLUX 3，开放免费试玩
title.en: 新世界模型Odyssey-3物理评测66.1分超FLUX 3，开放免费试玩

current_state.zh: World-model company Odyssey released Odyssey-3, opening a free Flash version that generates explorable worlds from text in real time and demonstrating reusable control modules for robots, cars and game characters, with the Pro model scoring 66.1 on Physics-IQ Verified to edge past FLUX 3's 64.35.
